license_required.quote: Any person who practices medicine or osteopathy or offers to do so in this state without a certificate of qualification having been issued in his or her behalf by the State Board of Medical Examiners and without a license and certificate of registration from the Medical Licensure Commission of Alabama shall be guilty of a Class C felony.

issuing_authority.value: Medical Licensure Commission of Alabama (license); State Board of Medical Examiners (certificate of qualification)
issuing_authority.quote: The above constituted commission shall have the exclusive power and authority to issue, revoke, and reinstate all licenses authorizing the licensee to practice medicine or osteopathy in the State of Alabama.

name.quote: The above constituted commission shall have the exclusive power and authority to issue, revoke, and reinstate all licenses authorizing the licensee to practice medicine or osteopathy in the State of Alabama.

type.quote: prior to exercising its power and authority to issue, revoke, or reinstate licenses, or to promulgate rules and regulations, the Medical Licensure Commission shall receive and consider but not be bound by the recommendation of the State Board of Medical Examiners.

moral_character_required.quote: if the commission finds that the applicant is of good moral character and has been duly certified by the board, the commission shall issue to such applicant a license

degree_required.value: Graduate of a medical school accredited by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education, the Commission on Osteopathic College Accreditation, or a medical school listed in the International Medical Education Directory or its equivalent
degree_required.quote: Is a graduate of a medical school accredited by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education, the Commission on Osteopathic College Accreditation, or a medical school listed in the International Medical Education Directory or its equivalent

accrediting_body.value: Liaison Committee on Medical Education (LCME) or Commission on Osteopathic College Accreditation (COCA)
accrediting_body.quote: Is a graduate of a medical school accredited by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education, the Commission on Osteopathic College Accreditation, or a medical school listed in the International Medical Education Directory or its equivalent

required.quote: Successfully completed graduate medical education approved by the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education or the American Osteopathic Association

kind.quote: Successfully completed graduate medical education approved by the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education or the American Osteopathic Association

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) or Comprehensive Osteopathic Medical Licensing Examination (COMLEX-USA)
exams.notes: Must pass each component within three attempts
exams.quote: Passed each component of the United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) or the Comprehensive Osteopathic Medical Licensing Examination (COMLEX-USA) within three attempts, or any of its predecessor examinations accepted by a state medical board as an equivalent examination for licensure purposes

interval_years.quote: Every person licensed to practice medicine or osteopathy in the State of Alabama shall, on or before December 31 of each succeeding year, apply to the commission for renewal of a certificate of registration which shall be effective during the next calendar year.

required.quote: After that date, successful completion of the requirements of the continuing medical education program shall be a requisite for license renewal.

available.quote: whose application for a license or certificate of qualification by reciprocity has been acted upon favorably by the board

requirements.value: Applicant must have application for certificate of qualification by reciprocity acted upon favorably by the State Board of Medical Examiners, after which the Medical Licensure Commission issues the license.
requirements.quote: whose application for a license or certificate of qualification by reciprocity has been acted upon favorably by the board

regulatory_model.quote: Any person who practices medicine or osteopathy or offers to do so in this state without a certificate of qualification having been issued in his or her behalf by the State Board of Medical Examiners and without a license and certificate of registration from the Medical Licensure Commission of Alabama shall be guilty of a Class C felony.

credential_type.quote: The above constituted commission shall have the exclusive power and authority to issue, revoke, and reinstate all licenses authorizing the licensee to practice medicine or osteopathy in the State of Alabama.

is_mandatory.quote: Any person who practices medicine or osteopathy or offers to do so in this state without a certificate of qualification having been issued in his or her behalf by the State Board of Medical Examiners and without a license and certificate of registration from the Medical Licensure Commission of Alabama shall be guilty of a Class C felony.

title_protection.quote: To use, in the conduct of any occupation or profession pertaining to the diagnosis or treatment of human disease or conditions, the designation "doctor," "doctor of medicine," "doctor of osteopathy," "physician," "surgeon," "physician and surgeon," "Dr.," "M.D.," or any combination thereof unless such a designation additionally contains the description of another branch of the healing arts for which a person has a license.

scope_protection.quote: Any person who practices medicine or osteopathy or offers to do so in this state without a certificate of qualification having been issued in his or her behalf by the State Board of Medical Examiners and without a license and certificate of registration from the Medical Licensure Commission of Alabama shall be guilty of a Class C felony.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud in applying for or procuring a certificate of qualification or license to practice medicine or osteopathy
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud in applying for or procuring a certificate of qualification to practice medicine or osteopathy or a license to practice medicine or osteopathy in the State of Alabama.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct as defined in statute or board/commission rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct as defined herein or in the rules and regulations promulgated by the commission.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine or osteopathy in a manner that endangers the health of patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing medicine or osteopathy in such a manner as to endanger the health of the patients of the practitioner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony; a copy of the record of conviction, certified to by the clerk of the court entering the conviction, shall be conclusive evidence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any crime or offense reflecting inability to practice medicine with due regard for health or safety of patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of any crime or offense which reflects the inability of the practitioner to practice medicine or osteopathy with due regard for the health or safety of his or her patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction for any violation of a federal or state law relating to controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction for any violation of a federal or state law relating to controlled substances

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of untruthful, deceptive, or improbable statements concerning qualifications or treatment effects
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of any untruthful or deceptive or improbable statements concerning the licensee's qualifications or the effects or results of his or her proposed treatment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Distribution of controlled substances for other than a legitimate medical purpose
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Distribution by prescribing, dispensing, furnishing, or supplying of controlled substances to any person or patient for any reason other than a legitimate medical purpose.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross malpractice, repeated malpractice, or gross negligence in the practice of medicine or osteopathy
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross malpractice or repeated malpractice or gross negligence in the practice of medicine or osteopathy.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Division of fees or agreement to split fees received for professional services for bringing or referring a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Division of fees or agreement to split or divide the fees received for professional services with any person for bringing or referring a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performance of unnecessary diagnostic tests or medical or surgical services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performance of unnecessary diagnostic tests or medical or surgical services.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Charging grossly excessive fees or filing false or fraudulent claims to third party payors
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Charging fees determined by the commission to be grossly excessive or intentionally filing or causing to be filed false or fraudulent claims, as defined by the commission, for medical or surgical services to any private or government third party payor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting the practice of medicine by any person not licensed by the commission
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting the practice of medicine by any person not licensed by the commission.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of fraud in filing Medicare, Medicaid, or third party payor claims
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of fraud in filing Medicare or Medicaid claims or conviction of fraud in filing claims to any third party payor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action taken by another state against the licensee based on similar acts
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any disciplinary action taken by another state against a licensee to practice medicine or osteopathy, based upon acts by the licensee similar to acts described in this section

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusal to appear before the State Board of Medical Examiners after formal written request
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusal to appear before the State Board of Medical Examiners after having been formally requested to do so in writing by the executive director of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any fraudulent or untrue statement to the commission or to the State Board of Medical Examiners
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any fraudulent or untrue statement to the commission or to the State Board of Medical Examiners.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Termination, revocation, probation, restriction, denial, or suspension of hospital staff privileges related to negligence, incompetence, moral turpitude, sexual misconduct, or substance abuse
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The termination, revocation, probation, restriction, denial, failure to renew, suspension, reduction, or resignation of staff privileges of a licensee by a hospital in this or any other state when such action is related to negligence or incompetence in the practice of medicine, moral turpitude, sexual misconduct, abusive or disruptive behavior, or drug or alcohol abuse.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being unable to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, inebriation, substance use, or mental or physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being unable to practice medicine or osteopathy with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness, inebriation, excessive use of drugs, narcotics, alcohol, chemicals, or any other substance, or as a result of any mental or physical condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being unable to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety due to demonstrated lack of basic medical knowledge or clinical competency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being unable to practice medicine or osteopathy with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of a demonstrated lack of basic medical knowledge or clinical competency.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Excessive prescribing, dispensing, furnishing, or supplying of a Schedule II controlled substance outside permitted therapeutic uses
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Excessive prescribing, dispensing, furnishing, or supplying of a Schedule II controlled substance.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain for a patient a medical record meeting minimum standards set by commission rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain for a patient a medical record which meets the minimum standards stated in the rules and regulations promulgated by the commission.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with any rule of the Board of Medical Examiners or Medical Licensure Commission
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with any rule of the Board of Medical Examiners or Medical Licensure Commission.

definition_quote.value: To diagnose, treat, correct, advise, or prescribe for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain, or other condition, physical or mental, real or imaginary, by any means or instrumentality
definition_quote.quote: To diagnose, treat, correct, advise, or prescribe for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain, or other condition, physical or mental, real or imaginary, by any means or instrumentality

value: maintaining office for diagnosis or treatment
methods_authorized.quote: To diagnose, treat, correct, advise, or prescribe for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain, or other condition, physical or mental, real or imaginary, by any means or instrumentality

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe legend drugs and controlled substances within the scope of legitimate medical practice; controlled substance prescribing via telehealth requires prior in-person encounter within 12 months
drug_authority.quote: A prescriber may prescribe a legend drug, medical supplies, or a controlled substance to a patient as a result of a telehealth medical service if the prescriber is authorized to prescribe the drug, supplies, or substance under applicable state and federal laws.

license_status_types.quote: the commission may, at its discretion, issue a license to practice medicine to an applicant who has been issued a certificate of qualification under the Retired Senior Volunteer Program

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must be graduates of a medical school listed in the International Medical Education Directory or its equivalent and meet all other compact eligibility requirements including USMLE/COMLEX passage and graduate medical education completion
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: Is a graduate of a medical school accredited by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education, the Commission on Osteopathic College Accreditation, or a medical school listed in the International Medical Education Directory or its equivalent

pain_management_education_required.quote: Each physician serving as the medical director at a practice location shall meet at least one of the following requirements: Successful completion of a residency program in physical medicine and rehabilitation, anesthesiology, addiction medicine, neurology, neurosurgery, family practice, preventive medicine, internal medicine, surgery, orthopedics, or psychiatry

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Excessive prescribing of Schedule II controlled substances is a disciplinary ground; Schedule II stimulants may only be prescribed for specified therapeutic conditions including narcolepsy, hyperkinesis, brain dysfunction, epilepsy, and clinically significant depression (limited to 30 days unless referred to specialist)
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: Excessive prescribing, dispensing, furnishing, or supplying of a Schedule II controlled substance. A physician or osteopath violates this subdivision if he or she prescribes, orders, dispenses, administers, supplies, or otherwise distributes any Schedule II amphetamine or Schedule II amphetamine like anorectic drug

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: Proof of a current registration with the Alabama Prescription Drug Monitoring Program.

pain_management_clinic_registration_requ.quote: All physicians providing pain management services shall obtain a pain management registration from the board.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A prescriber may prescribe legend drugs, medical supplies, or controlled substances via telehealth if authorized under applicable law. Controlled substance prescriptions via telehealth require synchronous audio or audio-visual communication, at least one prior in-person encounter within 12 months, and a legitimate medical purpose established within 12 months. Emergency exceptions apply.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A prescription for a controlled substance may only be issued as a result of telehealth medical services if each of the following apply: a. The telehealth visit includes synchronous audio or audio-visual communication using HIPAA compliant equipment with the prescriber responsible for the prescription. b. The prescriber has had at least one in-person encounter with the patient within the preceding 12 months. c. The prescriber has established a legitimate medical purpose for issuing the prescription within the preceding 12 months.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: Physicians who engage in the provision of telehealth medical services to any individual in this state must possess a full and active license to practice medicine or osteopathy issued by the Medical Licensure Commission.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: the member states of the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact have allied in common purpose to develop a comprehensive process that complements the existing licensing and regulatory authority of state medical boards

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: PHYSICIAN SUPERVISION. A formal relationship between a licensed assistant to a physician and a licensed physician under which the assistant to the physician is authorized to practice as evidenced by a written job description approved in accordance with this article.

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: A licensed assistant to physician registered to a licensed physician under an approved job description may prescribe legend drugs (not controlled substances) authorized in the job description and on the board-approved formulary; may also administer any legend drug authorized to prescribe
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: A licensed assistant to a physician registered to a licensed physician practicing under a job description approved in the manner prescribed by this article may prescribe legend drugs to patients, subject to both of the following conditions: (1) The drug type, dosage, quantity prescribed, and number of refills shall be authorized in an approved job description signed by the physicians to whom the assistant is registered. (2) The drug shall be on the formulary approved under the guidelines of the Board of Medical Examiners.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: The termination, revocation, probation, restriction, denial, failure to renew, suspension, reduction, or resignation of staff privileges of a licensee by a hospital in this or any other state when such action is related to negligence or incompetence in the practice of medicine, moral turpitude, sexual misconduct, abusive or disruptive behavior, or drug or alcohol abuse.

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: In order to prevent abuse, misuse, and conversion of controlled substances, and further administer this article, the board may contract with the Alabama Physician Wellness Committee, or any other nonprofit professional organization or nonprofit society that in its discretion it deems appropriate.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: upon a showing of probable cause to the board or commission that the doctor is not capable of practicing medicine or osteopathy with reasonable skill and safety to patients, the board or commission may order and direct the doctor in question to submit to either a physical, mental, or laboratory examination or any combination of such examinations

investigational_drug_protection.quote: Neither the board nor the commission may revoke, suspend, fail to renew, or take action against a physician's license based solely on his or her recommended or prescribed off-label medical treatment, unless the physician's recommended or prescribed off-label medical treatment presents a threat of significant harm to his or her patients or to the general public.
